protocol.kappa: 1 per supported dwell; 0 when none of six windows qualifies; no precision multiplication by window count
protocol.qualification: Fixed joint-pilot check on qualification sample blocks; no phase-evaluation samples used in support decisions
protocol.geometry: Mean selected window epoch; interpolate 0.2-second timing grid with linear boundary extrapolation for offsets at most 52.5ms
protocol.evaluation: Same CFO candidate banks, timing priors and whole-dwell folds as timing trial; all 18 dwell slots retained; retrospective conditional test
